basic_profile.bio: A 24-year-old based in Austin, Texas, recently got into PC building after years of gaming on consoles. Fascinated by technology and loves tinkering with hardware. Works as a junior IT support technician at a local company. Typically online during evenings and weekends. Currently single and enjoys watching tech reviews on YouTube. Dislikes slow internet and prefers spending time indoors, especially playing MMORPGs like World of Warcraft.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Mostly self-taught in the realm of PC building and gaming. Grew up playing video games and developed an interest in how they work, leading to experimenting with old PC parts. Has learned through watching online tutorials and participating in tech forums.
